_meta.description: SYNTHETIC reference registry for the fictional operator Acme (acme.example.com). Every phrase here is invented for documentation + tests — it is NOT a researched keyword program. Use it to see the file's SHAPE, then write your own from real buyer language.
harvest_sources: synthetic — invented for the bundled example, no real transcripts
operator_notes: The three tiers demonstrate the query grammar: high_precision (one quoted phrase), paired (quoted phrase AND a bare term), surgical_low_volume (a verbatim sentence that only the right person writes).

Register: the same concept is queried once per regional variant — 'production scheduling' and 'programación de la producción' are separate queries with separate languages, because the language picks the note template.

en-planning-spreadsheet is a deliberately STRETCHED example: it can surface posts about spreadsheets in general, not about scheduling. A real operator disables queries like it unless the note copy is broad enough to stay honest.
